race.comment: HANUMAN (7) keeps running you a proper race each and every time. Two strong wins were followed by a placing under a length away. Molly Bourke is down to ride and her experience on him is crucial. Two goes here for two wins also suggests this is a good play. DITTERICH (6) has been around the money this whole campaign. He will require some early fortune off the draw however hard to knock his desire. MISS CAPRICORN (5) goes back up in grade but it was a win. She backed up there and will be doing so once again. A mare in form is worth following. QUASIMOTO (9) chases the hatrick. They were in weaker events but still hard to be negative. Takes up that forward role again. KEVIN (8) is not that far away most of the time.
